items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: And the week before also Alan Jaffe was playing the tuba. Mm-hm. And then the rhythm session, they went out of the beat several times.

ctx.x: I asked him to bring him and funny enough also, Alan Jaffe asked him too. But he won't bring it down. He don't think that people would like it. They say he still can play it. They say he can play it if he laid off 15 years age. He could play it. But you don't want to go and love it. It's a shame because the way he played a clown is it's just a saxophone style. It's nothing else.
Yeah, his tone has changed too.
